results.title: Show Notes — The Science of Success Podcast
results.content: # The Science of Success Podcast. # How Asking Can Transform Your life with Mark Victor Hansen and Crystal Dwyer Hansen. Mark Victor Hansen is an American inspirational and motivational speaker, trainer and author. Mark has spoken to over 6,000 audiences world-wide and continues to receive high accolades from his audiences as one of the most dynamic and compelling speakers and leaders of our time. * **You don't get what you deserve, you get what you ask for.**. * We are all born with the natural ability to ask, and life crushes it out of us. * What does the science say about WHY we don't ask? * If you're wiling to put yourself out there and ask for what you want, people will HELP YOU because people LIKE To help other people. * How do you handle a NO when you ask for something? * You have to take a "reflective journey" to figure out where you are, what you want, where you want to go, and how to get there.
